purpose: The control tier: Cascade X8 reference tracking through the existing plant and NMPC seam, with the generic learner and the structured belief driving the same trials.

information_budget.meaning: The recipe's own evaluation plan on this sample grid. The generic arm plans exactly this horizon; it is not rolled past it.

telemetry.meaning: The command bounds are a declared fact about the vehicle's command space, supplied to both arms. Neither model infers them.

calibration.command_policy: requested command held for the full sample interval
calibration.meaning: Three eight-second recordings fit both arms and one further recording is reserved and never enters either fit in any role.

tracking_reference.meaning: The trim state carried forward at its own initial world velocity, with a small cosine altitude variation and the matching climb rate.

trial.pacing: paced fixed steps; the plant's simulated clock slows when control runs late
trial.plant_prewarm: one discarded step at the initial command, then a reset, before the trial clock starts
trial.meaning: Both arms drive a freshly reset plant from the same initial state and command, over the same reference, for the same number of intervals. Arm order alternates between repetitions.

controller.precision: trials run at the default JAX precision; only fits enable x64
controller.meaning: Both arms run the same bounded shooting solver under the seam's explicit no-evidence override, so neither is priced for uncertainty it does not carry.

structured.fit: glassbox.fitting.fit on the three calibration recordings
structured.horizon_policy: glassbox.control.fitted.default_solver_policy, capped by the belief's own forecast-error evidence
structured.meaning: The frozen arm of examples/cascade_refinement.py, fitted the way that example fits it, planning over the fitted mean.

generic.fit: glassbox.experimental.default_model.fit on the same three calibration recordings, adapted to the learner's fifteen observed channels
generic.horizon_policy: the recipe's own fitted horizon_s; a longer horizon is refused, not extrapolated
generic.state_map: position integrated trapezoidally from predicted world velocity; predicted rotation entries projected onto the nearest rotation and read back as a quaternion
generic.history: carried interval by interval from observed states and applied commands, reset at the trial start, never padded
generic.warm_up: the trial holds its initial command until the loop has observed the explicit-difference window; those intervals are scored like every other
generic.meaning: The generic learner presented to the same seam, claiming no covariance.

metrics.definition: glassbox.core.metrics.state_rmse_metrics over every completed control interval after the shared initial state
metrics.terminated: a trial that did not complete every declared interval with finite observed states
metrics.meaning: Deadline misses are host-specific scheduling measurements and inform rather than gate. Wall times are not a real-time claim.

reference.meaning: When the reference file exists beside this manifest, no trial's generic position or attitude RMSE may exceed its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005. A run copies the reference it compared into its output directory and records its sha256, and verify anchors that copy to the committed file rather than believing it.
reference.gates_the_rule: The same recorded value decides which cases the rule gates. A trial and metric whose reference value is itself at or below this run's structured arm on that trial is a case the reference meets, and the rule is a gate there; a case the reference already fails is reported only. With no reference compared there is no case the reference meets, and the rule is reported everywhere.

decision.rule: On every trial, the generic arm's position RMSE and attitude RMSE are at or below the structured arm's on that same trial.
decision.rule_met: Reported separately from the decision, on every run. The control row of docs/status.md is met only when the rule holds on every trial and metric, which is a stronger statement than an accepted run.
decision.gates_from: this manifest. A run is accepted only when no metric regresses past its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005, the rule holds on every trial and metric the reference already meets it on, and nothing structural fails. A case the reference already fails is reported, not gated: an enforced rule the incumbent does not meet would block every change rather than measure one.
decision.structural: Always fails closed, whatever the reference says: a trial missing, duplicated, undeclared, terminated, short of its declared intervals, or carrying a metric that is not a finite number.
decision.meaning: A Cascade X8 tracking measurement of this trial set only. Not hardware readiness, not a real-time claim, and not calibrated uncertainty.
